meta.notes_zh:
1. ※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有
身分證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入
院日期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使
用，並攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別
特定當事人。
2. 原則上每位醫事人員登錄 1筆資料。
3. 2017年僅擷取執業狀態(WORK_STATUS)為01：執業之資料。
4. 2017年資料健保分區空白，代表錯誤資料。(執業中，但未有執業機構)
5. 2020年資料新增 2欄位：執業縣市、執業鄉鎮。 主鍵與 無
meta.data_description_en:
1. The data belongs to the Department of Medical Affairs, Ministry of Health and Welfare.
2. The data years are 2010, 2011, 2016, 2017, 2020.
meta.notes_en: 1. To meet clinical cancer-care needs, from ROC year 98 (2009) the Health Promotion Administration began planning to add site-specific-factor data to the Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form database; for public-health reasons, smoking, betel-nut chewing, alcohol use, height and weight were also added and revised in the ROC-100 (2011) cancer-registry abstracting manual. 2. Beyond the cancers reported in 2007 (cervical, breast, colorectal, oral, lung, liver) and those added in 2008 (prostate, stomach, esophagus, bladder), 2009 added nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic cancers; 2010 expanded to the top 10 cancers in men and women (oral, colorectal, liver, lung, breast, cervical...).
